description: Peter Parker balances university life with a growing gallery of enemies, from the Lizard and Spider-Slayers to Doctor Octopus, Venom and the Hobgoblin, while learning how personal every battle can become.

s01e01.description: Peter discovers that Dr. Curt Connors has transformed into the Lizard and is hunting beneath Manhattan while Jameson wants photographic proof.

s01e02.description: Jameson helps create the Scorpion to defeat Spider-Man, only to unleash a stronger and far less controllable enemy.

s01e03.description: Norman Osborn hires Spencer Smythe to capture Spider-Man with a deadly robotic hunter built specifically to counter his abilities.

s01e04.description: Alistair Smythe blames Spider-Man for his father's fate and joins the Kingpin to deploy a new generation of Spider-Slayers.

s01e05.description: A costumed illusionist frames Spider-Man for robberies, forcing Peter to expose Mysterio's tricks before the city accepts the impostor's story.

s01e06.description: Doctor Octopus kidnaps Felicia Hardy for ransom, confronting Peter with a brilliant former mentor who has turned his science toward crime.

s01e07.description: A strange organism from a crashed space shuttle bonds with Peter, giving Spider-Man new power while changing his temperament.

s01e08.description: Peter learns the alien suit is alive and tries to separate from it as Eddie Brock's hatred of Spider-Man deepens.

s01e09.description: The rejected symbiote bonds with Eddie Brock to create Venom, an enemy who knows Spider-Man's identity and every weakness.

s01e10.description: Kraven comes to New York hunting a scientist whose transformation is tied to the same serum that made him a superhuman predator.

s01e11.description: Norman Osborn hires the Hobgoblin against the Kingpin, creating a masked wildcard eager to seize the criminal empire for himself.

s01e12.description: Hobgoblin's attempt to replace the Kingpin pulls Spider-Man, Osborn and Fisk into a shifting contest of blackmail and betrayal.

s01e13.description: S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts the shape-shifting Chameleon as he impersonates key figures to sabotage an international peace agreement.
